description: Empower shoppers with precise sizing guidance, including height-specific sizing options and clear model specifications. Eliminating fit-uncertainty directly drives checkout confidence and reduces fit-related returns.
supporting_unmet_needs: Height-specific sizing options (e.g., petite or tall fits) and explicit inseam/length guidance on size charts.
Accurate sizing guidance to ensure perfect fit along with good quality
Clear display of model measurements/sizes and accessible sizing assistance to confidently pick the right size.

description: Establish strict seller quality control and transparent pricing standards across all platform listings. Elevating baseline product standards and eliminating misleading sale pricing reinforces consumer trust and drives repeat conversions.
supporting_unmet_needs: Transparent sale pricing and reliable seller quality control.
Continued maintenance of high product standards and smooth operational policies across all listings.

description: Streamline return, exchange, and refund workflows while improving order accuracy and customer service availability. Providing real-time tracking visibility and automated refunds protects brand loyalty and reduces operational churn.
supporting_unmet_needs: A consistently seamless, fast, and hassle-free process for returning or exchanging products.
Prompt, automated refund processing with clear tracking visibility and full reimbursement to original payment methods
Accurate order fulfillment and accessible, supportive customer care to quickly resolve wrong or damaged deliveries.
